problem.text: The extension source list previously embedded absolute checkout paths in the build configuration.

reasoning.text: Expressing source paths relative to setup.py removes the checkout-specific absolute prefix while retaining the discovered source files.

impact.text: This makes extension source metadata independent of the checkout's absolute location under the usual project-root invocation.

limitations: No package installation, distribution build or native compilation was run; compatibility improvements are inferred rather than measured.
Source discovery still starts from a working-directory-relative directory. The change does not establish support for invoking setup.py from arbitrary working directories.

claims.text: The source-list comprehension still walks exllamav3/exllamav3_ext and selects .c, .cpp and .cu files. Only path normalization changes: abspath becomes relpath with os.path.dirname(__file__) as its base.
The resulting list feeds PyTorch's CUDAExtension when Torch is available and EXLLAMA_NOCOMPILE is absent. Compiler flags, source filtering and the precompilation gate remain unchanged.

A standard-library path-expression check modeled project-root invocation using both relative and absolute setup.py filenames. For bindings.cpp, the new expression produced a relative path resolving to the same target as the old absolute path. This checked path arithmetic, not the packaging implementation.

annotation.summary: Changes native extension source paths from absolute checkout paths to paths relative to setup.py, without changing source selection or compilation settings.

argv:
import os
p='exllamav3/exllamav3_ext/bindings.cpp'
base=os.getcwd()
for setup_file in ('setup.py', os.path.join(base,'setup.py')):
 old=os.path.abspath(p)
 new=os.path.relpath(p,start=os.path.dirname(setup_file))
 assert new==p
 assert os.path.abspath(new)==old
 print({'setup_file_form':'relative' if setup_file=='setup.py' else 'absolute','new':new,'same_target':os.path.abspath(new)==old,'old_absolute':os.path.isabs(old),'new_absolute':os.path.isabs(new)})
